newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: AGENCY SAYS DANES BUY MORE BALTIJOS SHARES.
newsitem.headline: AGENCY SAYS DANES BUY MORE BALTIJOS SHARES.

text.p: Lithuania's privatisation agency refused on Wednesday to name Denmark's Odense as the buyer of a 16.27 percent stake in Baltijos Shipyard but confirmed that the buyer was Danish.
"The buyer was from Denmark," Vytis Atkochiunas, the head of the country's privatisation agency, told Reuters.
"The state sold all of its stake in the firm," Atkochiunas added.

The stake was sold on the bourse earlier this week and most market players believed Odense, which previously acquired 43 percent of the shipyard's shares, was the buyer. The whole deal was worth 11.4 million litas and the shares went for 10.10 litas.

The Euro affairs ministry said earlier that Denmark's Maersk, part of the same group which owns Odense, offered to buy the state's chunk of Baltijos Shipyard at a price exceeding its price on the bourse.
Baltijos Shipyard was traded at 7.95 litas on the central market on Wednesday.
